details.description: Llama 3.2 11B Vision Instruct is Meta's 10.6-billion-parameter multimodal chat model, released September 25, 2024, which adds a separately trained vision adapter with cross-attention layers to the Llama 3.1 language model. It is instruction-tuned for visual recognition, image reasoning, captioning and answering questions about images such as charts, graphs and maps, and its pretraining data has a cutoff of December 2023. On this catalog entry it has a 16,384-token context window.
advantages: Scores 88.4 ANLS on DocVQA (test) per Meta's model card.
Scores 83.4% on ChartQA (test, chain-of-thought) per Meta's model card.
Scores 75.2% on VQAv2 (test) per Meta's model card.
Scores 50.7% on MMMU (val, chain-of-thought) per Meta's model card.
Scores 73.0% on MMLU (chain-of-thought) for text-only tasks per Meta's model card.
disadvantages: Meta states image+text tasks are officially supported in English only, even though text-only tasks support 8 languages.
Pretraining data cutoff of December 2023, per Meta's model card.
use_cases: Document understanding, including charts and graphs
Visual grounding, such as pinpointing objects described in natural language

sources.title: Llama 3.2: Revolutionizing edge AI and vision with open, customizable models

notes: Meta's model card states a 128K-token context window generally; this catalog entry gives it a 16,384-token window, which I kept per instructions. The languages list reflects Meta's text-only language support; Meta's card states image+text tasks are officially supported in English only, which I noted as a disadvantage rather than in the languages list. Benchmark numbers were cross-checked between Meta's Hugging Face card and its GitHub MODEL_CARD_VISION.md and matched exactly.
